s: November 8, 2025 - Ella Marija Lani Yellich-O'Connor (born 7 November 1996), known by her stage name Lorde, is a New Zealand singer-songwriter. She was signed to Universal Music at the age of 13. Lorde's first album, Pure Heroine, was released in September 2013. It was followed by Melodrama in 2017.
